entries.text: 造成{d}点伤害。施加{n}层易碎。
造成{d}点伤害。施加{n}层冻伤。

entries.source: Deal {d} damage to a random enemy 3 times.
entries.text: 对随机敌人造成{d}点伤害，重复3次。
对所有敌人造成{d}点伤害。
造成{d}点伤害。施加{n}层湿透。
获得{b}点护甲。造成{d}点伤害。

entries.source: Deal {d} damage. If the enemy is Brittle, gain 1 Cheer and draw 1.
entries.text: 造成{d}点伤害。若目标有易碎，获得1点欢呼并抽1张礼物。
对所有敌人施加{n}层湿透。

entries.source: Gain {b} Wrap. Next turn, draw 1 extra.
entries.text: 获得{b}点护甲。下回合额外抽1张礼物。

entries.source: Deal {d} damage to ALL enemies 3 times.
entries.text: 对所有敌人造成{d}点伤害，重复3次。
造成{d}点伤害。恢复{n}点生命。消耗。

entries.source: Deal damage equal to your Wrap.
entries.text: 造成等同于当前护甲值的伤害。

entries.source: Deal {d} damage. Double the enemy's Frostbite.
entries.text: 造成{d}点伤害。目标的冻伤层数翻倍。

entries.source: Next turn, gain 2 Cheer and draw {n} extra.
entries.text: 下回合获得2点欢呼并额外抽{n}张礼物。

entries.source: Gain {b} Wrap. Apply {n} Chilled to ALL enemies.
entries.text: 获得{b}点护甲。对所有敌人施加{n}层寒冷。
施加{n}层湿透和{n}层易碎。消耗。

entries.source: Add a random gift to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.
entries.text: 将1张随机礼物加入手牌，本回合费用为0。

entries.source: At the end of your turn, gain {n} Wrap.
entries.text: 每回合结束时，获得{n}点护甲。

entries.source: At the end of your turn, deal {n} damage to ALL enemies.
entries.text: 每回合结束时，对所有敌人造成{n}点伤害。

entries.source: At the start of your turn, apply {n} Frostbite to ALL enemies.
entries.text: 每回合开始时，对所有敌人施加{n}层冻伤。

entries.source: At the start of your turn, draw 1 extra gift.
entries.text: 每回合开始时，额外抽1张礼物。

entries.source: Deal {d} damage to ALL enemies. Apply {n} Brittle to ALL.
entries.text: 对所有敌人造成{d}点伤害，并施加{n}层易碎。

entries.source: Deal {d} damage. If this kills, gain {n} Max HP. Consume.
entries.text: 造成{d}点伤害。若击败目标，增加{n}点生命上限。消耗。
获得{n}点欢呼。抽2张礼物。消耗。

entries.source: At the start of your turn, heal {n}.
entries.text: 每回合开始时，恢复{n}点生命。

entries.source: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Cheer.
entries.text: 每回合开始时，获得1点欢呼。

entries.source: At the start of your turn, gain {n} Might.
entries.text: 每回合开始时，获得{n}层力量。
无法赠送。留下它会降低圣诞精神。

entries.source: Ungiftable. At the end of your turn, lose 2 HP.
entries.text: 无法赠送。回合结束时失去2点生命。

entries.source: Deal 4 damage to a random enemy.
entries.text: 对随机敌人造成4点伤害。

entries.source: Pops 1 Grumpy pip on any monster.
entries.text: 降低一名怪物的1格暴躁值。
此礼物的数值翻倍。消耗。

entries.source: At the start of each battle, gain 1 Nimble. After each battle, gain 15 Cookies.
entries.text: 战斗开始时获得1层灵巧。战斗结束后获得15块饼干。

entries.source: At the start of each battle, apply 1 Soggy to ALL enemies. Dazzling!
entries.text: 战斗开始时，对所有敌人施加1层湿透。真耀眼！

entries.source: At the end of each battle, heal 6 HP.
entries.text: 战斗结束后恢复6点生命。

entries.source: At the start of each battle, draw 2 extra gifts.
entries.text: 战斗开始时额外抽2张礼物。

entries.source: At the start of each battle, gain 10 Wrap.
entries.text: 战斗开始时获得10点护甲。

entries.source: Gain 1 extra Cheer on the first turn of each battle.
entries.text: 每场战斗的第一回合额外获得1点欢呼。

entries.source: At the start of each battle, apply 1 Brittle to ALL enemies.
entries.text: 战斗开始时，对所有敌人施加1层易碎。

entries.source: At the start of each battle, gain 1 Might.
entries.text: 战斗开始时获得1层力量。

entries.source: At the start of each battle, gain 1 Nimble.
entries.text: 战斗开始时获得1层灵巧。

entries.source: At the start of each battle, gain 3 Holly.
entries.text: 战斗开始时获得3层冬青。

entries.source: Every 10th Attack you give deals double damage.
entries.text: 每赠送第10张攻击礼物，其伤害翻倍。

entries.source: If you end your turn with 0 Wrap, gain 6 Wrap.
entries.text: 若回合结束时没有护甲，获得6点护甲。

entries.source: Every 3rd Attack in a turn grants 1 Might.
entries.text: 每回合赠送第3张攻击礼物时，获得1层力量。

entries.source: Every 3rd Skill in a turn grants 1 Nimble.
entries.text: 每回合赠送第3张技能礼物时，获得1层灵巧。
每第3回合额外获得1点欢呼。

entries.source: Gain 1 extra Cheer every turn. Spirit fades 1 faster each night.
entries.text: 每回合额外获得1点欢呼。每晚额外流失1点圣诞精神。

entries.source: Leaving coal or curses GAINS 2 Spirit instead of losing it.
entries.text: 留下煤块或诅咒时，改为获得2点圣诞精神。

entries.source: Whenever you leave a gift, gain 15 Cookies.
entries.text: 每次留下礼物时获得15块饼干。

entries.source: Whenever you leave a gift, gain 3 extra Spirit.
entries.text: 每次留下礼物时额外获得3点圣诞精神。

entries.source: Whenever you leave a gift, Rewrap (upgrade) a random gift.
entries.text: 每次留下礼物时，重新包装一张随机礼物，使其升级。

entries.source: With 12 or fewer gifts, you may skip leaving a gift.
entries.text: 礼物数量不超过12张时，可以跳过留下礼物。

entries.source: Resting by the fire heals 15 extra HP.
entries.text: 在壁炉旁休息时，额外恢复15点生命。

entries.source: Everything in the Elf Shop is 20% cheaper.
entries.text: 精灵商店所有商品打八折。

entries.source: If you give 3 or fewer gifts in a turn, draw 3 extra next turn.
entries.text: 若本回合赠送不超过3张礼物，下回合额外抽3张。
拾取时增加10点生命上限。

entries.source: Up to 15 Wrap is kept between turns.
entries.text: 每回合最多保留15点护甲。

entries.source: Whenever an enemy is defeated, gain 1 Cheer and draw 1.
entries.text: 每击败一名敌人，获得1点欢呼并抽1张礼物。

entries.source: At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
entries.text: 回合结束时，对随机敌人造成3点伤害。

entries.source: Gift rewards offer 4 choices instead of 3.
Once per run, when you would fall, rise with 50% HP.
entries.text: 每局一次，倒下时以50%生命重新站起。
对所有敌人造成10点伤害。
对所有敌人施加2层湿透。

entries.source: Add a random Rare gift to your hand. It costs 0.
entries.text: 将一张随机稀有礼物加入手牌，费用为0。

entries.source: Escape a normal battle (no rewards, no gift to leave).
entries.text: 逃离普通战斗，不获得奖励，也不需要留下礼物。

entries.source: Rewrap (upgrade) all gifts in your hand this battle.
entries.text: 本场战斗中，升级手牌中的所有礼物。
恢复相当于生命上限30%的生命。

entries.source: Ran out of the North Pole ovens the moment the door opened and had been living off his own crumbs for months.
entries.text: 烤炉的门一开就逃出了北极，靠自己掉落的饼干屑过了好几个月。

entries.source: Came to life to a song once. Has been waiting for another one ever since.
entries.text: 曾因一首歌获得生命，从此一直等待下一首歌。

entries.source: Fell off the tree Last Christmas  and has held a grudge against holidays ever since.
entries.text: 去年圣诞从树上摔了下来，从此对节日怀恨在心。

entries.source: Despite their name, chimney rats prefer to live in arch-shaped holes cut into walls.
entries.text: 名字虽叫烟囱鼠，却更喜欢住在墙上的拱形小洞里。

entries.source: Every string of lights that was ever stuffed in a box, tangled into one.
entries.text: 所有被胡乱塞进盒子的灯串，最终纠缠成了这一团。

entries.source: A wind-up toy that kept going after its mechanism broke. It only knows forward.
entries.text: 发条坏了仍不停向前的玩具。它只知道前进。

entries.source: Cracks nuts for a living and wants everyone to know it.
entries.text: 以夹核桃为生，而且非要让所有人都知道。
永远迈着整齐划一的步伐。

entries.source: Has a habit of popping out at the worst possible moment. The reason is anxiety.
entries.text: 总在最不合时宜的时候弹出来，其实是因为焦虑。

entries.source: Gifted and regifted forty times. All it ever wants is to be eaten.
entries.text: 被当作礼物转送了四十次。它唯一的心愿就是被吃掉。

entries.source: A shapely fallen angel made out of fresh snow.
entries.text: 用新雪塑成的堕落天使。

entries.source: A spilled mug of eggnog that got ideas. Loves anything warm and cosy.
entries.text: 一杯打翻后有了自己想法的蛋奶酒，喜欢温暖舒适的东西。

entries.source: Hangs in frozen caves. A good jingle echoes for days in there.
entries.text: 倒挂在冰洞里，一声好听的铃响能回荡好几天。

entries.source: Hates the noise, the noise, the NOISE. Secretly loves a well-tied bow.
entries.text: 讨厌吵闹，讨厌喧嚣，讨厌一切噪声。却偷偷喜欢系得漂亮的蝴蝶结。

entries.source: Quit the workshop over unpaid overtime. Always planning a getaway.
entries.text: 因拿不到加班费离开工坊，总在盘算下一条逃跑路线。

entries.source: Built from every lump of coal ever given. Craves a little spark.
entries.text: 由曾被送出去的煤块堆成，渴望一点火花。

entries.source: A candy cane that grew fangs. A soft tune still charms it.
entries.text: 长出毒牙的糖杖，柔和的旋律仍能打动它。

entries.source: Mistletoe that got tired of waiting for kisses.
entries.text: 等不到亲吻，终于失去耐心的槲寄生。

entries.source: Krampus's little helpers. Pure mischief; nothing you give them is ever enough.
entries.text: 坎卜斯的帮凶，满脑子恶作剧。送它什么都不够。

entries.source: Commander of the Nutcracker army. Accepts only the finest tribute.
entries.text: 胡桃夹军团的统帅，只接受最上等的贡品。

entries.source: Lonely, enormous and very loud. A lullaby calms it right down.
entries.text: 孤独、庞大又吵闹。一首摇篮曲就能让它安静下来。

entries.source: Hoards coal and cookies alike. Values a gift by its price tag.
entries.text: 囤积煤炭，也囤积饼干。衡量礼物只看价签。

entries.source: Led the sleigh team for a hundred Christmases. Still answers to the jingle of sleigh bells.
entries.text: 带领雪橇队度过了一百个圣诞节，至今仍会回应雪橇的铃声。

entries.source: Lives in a gingerbread house. Will trade anything for a sprinkle of sparkle.
entries.text: 住在姜饼屋里，愿意用任何东西换一点闪闪发亮的装饰。

entries.source: Nips noses for fun. Can't sit still; loves anything bouncy.
entries.text: 以冻红别人的鼻子为乐。片刻也坐不住，喜欢会弹跳的东西。

entries.source: Read the whole Naughty List in one night. Somewhere under the coal, he's still Nick.
entries.text: 一夜之间读完了整本顽皮名单。煤灰之下，他仍然是尼克。

entries.source: What Santa becomes when the coal wins. There is no gift for this.
entries.text: 煤炭吞噬了圣诞老人之后的模样。没有礼物能打动它。

entries.source: The list itself, growing bigger with every naughty deed. Santa never had a chance.
entries.text: 每一次顽皮都会让这份名单变得更长，圣诞老人从一开始就无力招架。
现在该叫我恐怖姜饼人！

entries.source: Imma stick you with my carrot!
I'll keep you frozen till New Year!
Tink tink! You'll break before I do!
I only know how to move forward.
Nuts and grannies get cracked alike!
entries.text: 核桃和老太太，我都能夹碎！

entries.source: Round and round the handle turns...

entries.text: 我是可爱的水果小甜心！

entries.source: Feelin' thirsty? How about a PUNCH?
entries.text: 渴了吗？来一记水果重拳！

entries.source: I knew I should've stayed in Mt. Moon.
entries.text: 早知道就留在月亮山了。

entries.source: You wouldn't like me when I'm grumpy.
entries.text: 我暴躁起来，你可受不了。

entries.source: Your cookies or your life! ...Actually, just the cookies.
entries.text: 要饼干还是要命！其实只要饼干。
圣诞老人从不付加班费。

entries.source: Every naughty child... made me BIGGER.
entries.text: 每个顽皮的孩子，都让我更强大。

entries.source: Refresh yourssself with sssome peppermint venom!
A kiss? How about a SQUEEZE.
The Master is coming! Heh heh!
You're just another nut to crush.
Coal is the gift that keeps on giving.
entries.text: 煤炭才是源源不断的礼物。

entries.source: The sleigh is broken. And so are the reins.
We pulled for HIM. Now we run wild!
entries.text: 我们曾为他拉车，如今只为自己狂奔！

entries.source: What a ho-ho-horrible night to have a curse!
entries.text: 中了诅咒的夜晚，真是糟、糟、糟透了！

entries.source: SANTA IS GONE. KRAMPUS IS FOREVER!
entries.text: 圣诞老人消失了！坎卜斯永存！

entries.source: I CAN SEE INTO YOUR HEART.
A tiny elf shivers in a snowdrift, clutching a broken compass. "I may have taken a wrong turn at the candy cane forest..."
entries.text: 一个小精灵抱着坏掉的指南针，在雪堆里瑟瑟发抖。“我可能在糖杖森林转错了弯……”

entries.source: Half-finished toys line the dusty benches. The tools are still warm, as if the elves left in a hurry.
entries.text: 落满灰尘的工作台上摆着半成品玩具。工具还温热，精灵们似乎走得很匆忙。

entries.source: A ragged group of carolers is singing in front of a house. They look like they've been at it for quite a long time. Their voices crack with cold.
entries.text: 一群衣衫单薄的歌手站在门前唱颂歌。他们似乎唱了很久，嗓音冻得发颤。

entries.source: A frozen pond blocks the path. As you take a closer look, you note coins that twinkle under the ice. The ice creaks under your weight.
entries.text: 一片冰封的池塘挡住去路。冰下有硬币闪烁，脚下的冰层却吱呀作响。

entries.source: On a windowsill, you notice an enormous cookie jar. A note reads: FOR SANTA ONLY.
entries.text: 窗台上摆着一个巨大的饼干罐。旁边的纸条写着：仅供圣诞老人享用。

entries.source: An old woman sells snow globes. You take one from her hands almost absentmindedly.
entries.text: 一位老妇人在卖雪景球。你不知不觉间接过了她手中的一只。

entries.source: Santa's reserve reindeer pace in their stalls, hungry and restless.
entries.text: 圣诞老人的后备驯鹿饿得焦躁不安，在栏里来回踱步。

entries.source: You stop by a wishing well and look inside. You see countless coins far below.
entries.text: 你在许愿井边停下，探头望去，深处闪烁着数不清的硬币。

entries.source: Two elves with red eyes block the path. "Hey, stranger! How about we play a game? Winner takes all!"
entries.text: 两个红眼精灵挡住去路。“陌生人，玩个游戏怎么样？赢家拿走一切！”

entries.source: The conveyor belts at a toy factory still run. Toys roll by, waiting to be wrapped.
entries.text: 玩具工厂的传送带仍在运转，一件件玩具等待着被包装。

entries.source: A cottage made entirely of gingerbread. You feel as though there's something or someone inside.
entries.text: 一栋完全由姜饼搭成的小屋。你感觉里面有什么东西，或者什么人。

entries.source: Santa's sleigh lies tipped in a ditch, one of its runners snapped. The seat is still warm.
entries.text: 圣诞老人的雪橇翻倒在沟里，一根滑板已经折断。座位却还温热。

entries.source: A boy pelts you with snowballs. "Santa never came last year! Why in the hell should I be nice?"
entries.text: 一个男孩朝你扔雪球。“圣诞老人去年根本没来！我凭什么还要乖？”

entries.source: A great arch of mistletoe appears above the path.
entries.text: 一座巨大的槲寄生拱门出现在道路上方。

entries.source: A stooped toymaker fixes a rocking horse by candlelight. "Need anything mended, dear?"
entries.text: 一位驼背的玩具匠在烛光下修理木马。“亲爱的，有什么需要修补的吗？”

entries.source: A howling blizzard swallows the road. You can barely see the tip of your own nose.
entries.text: 呼啸的暴风雪吞没了道路，你几乎看不清自己的鼻尖。

entries.source: A postman lies stuck in a snowdrift, his bag bursting with letters to Santa.
entries.text: 一位邮递员陷在雪堆里，邮袋塞满了写给圣诞老人的信。

entries.source: A cheerful elf runs a cocoa stand in the middle of nowhere. "Marshmallows are extra!"
entries.text: 荒郊野外，一个快乐的精灵经营着热可可摊。“棉花糖要另外加钱哦！”

entries.source: A fishing hole and an abandoned rod. Something tugs at the line.
entries.text: 冰洞边有一根无人看管的鱼竿。有什么东西正在拉扯鱼线。

entries.source: Music drifts from a ballroom where nutcrackers waltz to the tune. One of them bows to you.
entries.text: 舞厅里传来音乐，胡桃夹子们正跳着华尔兹。其中一个向你鞠躬。

entries.source: A lonely stocking hangs on a fence post, bulging with something.
entries.text: 一只孤零零的圣诞袜挂在篱笆上，里面鼓鼓囊囊。

entries.source: A field of perfect, untouched snow sparkles under the moon.
entries.text: 月光下，一片无人踏足的雪地闪闪发亮。

entries.source: A star has fallen into a snowbank, still glowing and sparking.
entries.text: 一颗星星落进雪堆，仍在发光，迸出细小的火花。

entries.source: A masked stranger holds out a wrapped box. "Care for a swap, {title}? No peeking."
entries.text: 一个蒙面陌生人递来包装好的盒子。“{title}，要交换礼物吗？不许偷看。”

entries.source: A small, friendly snowman sits alone in a park. It years for companionship.
entries.text: 一个友善的小雪人独自坐在公园里，渴望有人陪伴。

entries.source: An ornate mirror shows you young, laughing beside an even younger Santa.
entries.text: 华丽的镜子映出年轻的你，身旁是更加年轻的圣诞老人，你们笑得很开心。

entries.source: Walk him home (lose 6 HP, gain a relic)
entries.text: 送他回家（失去6点生命，获得遗物）
修修补补（升级一张礼物）
搜寻物资（随机礼物和30块饼干）
一起唱歌（精神+10，恢复5点生命）
学习歌曲（获得跑调颂歌）
滑过去（50%获得60块饼干，否则失去10点生命）

entries.source: Reach in deep (+75 Cookies, gain Lump of Coal)
entries.text: 往深处掏（75块饼干，获得煤块）
只吃一块（恢复10点生命，精神-2）
摇晃雪景球（变换一张礼物）

entries.source: Ride one (lose 10 HP, gain a relic)
entries.text: 骑上一头（失去10点生命，获得遗物）

entries.source: Toss a gift in (leave a gift)
entries.text: 投入一张礼物（留下礼物）
喝井水（恢复15点生命，精神-5）
接受游戏（与两个坎卜斯小鬼战斗）

entries.source: Work overtime (lose 7 HP, choose a gift)
entries.text: 加班（失去7点生命，选择礼物）

entries.source: Take a nap on the sacks (heal 12)
entries.text: 在礼袋上小睡（恢复12点生命）

entries.source: Nibble the roof (heal 20, gain Lump of Coal)
entries.text: 啃屋顶（恢复20点生命，获得煤块）
搜查座位（获得遗物，精神-6）

entries.source: Give him a gift (leave; DOUBLE Spirit)
entries.text: 送他礼物（留下礼物，获得双倍精神）
打雪仗（生命-5，获得升级的雪球）
从拱门下走过（恢复12点生命，获得槲寄生之吻）

entries.source: Cut a sprig (gain a random Uncommon gift)
entries.text: 剪下一枝（随机罕见礼物）
修补礼物（升级两张随机礼物）

entries.source: Buy a toy (50 Cookies, choose a gift)
entries.text: 花50块饼干买玩具（选择礼物）

entries.source: Drink a potion for warmth (lose a potion)
entries.text: 喝药水取暖（失去一瓶药水）
烧信取暖（恢复12点生命，精神-12）
小杯20块饼干（恢复18点生命）
打包45块饼干（两瓶随机药水）
共舞（生命-5，升级一张礼物）
看看里面（药水和30块饼干）
往里面装礼物（留下礼物）
做个雪地天使（恢复8点生命，精神+6）
拾起星星（树顶星或100块饼干）

entries.source: Build him a friend (-4 HP, +10 Spirit)
entries.text: 为他堆个朋友（生命-4，精神+10）

entries.source: Take his scarf (gain Scarf Wrap+, -8 Spirit)
entries.text: 拿走围巾（获得升级围巾，精神-8）

entries.source: Reach into the memory (duplicate a gift, -6 Max HP)
entries.text: 伸手触碰回忆（复制一张礼物，生命上限-6）
二十四个夜晚，拯救圣诞节

entries.source:
Runs the North Pole while Santa
takes all the credit.
entries.text:
北极的大小事务由她打理，
功劳却都归圣诞老人。

entries.source:
Head toymaker of Santa's
workshop and his trusted advisor.
entries.text:
圣诞工坊的首席玩具匠，
也是圣诞老人信赖的顾问。

entries.source:
The reindeer with the brightest
nose and the biggest heart.
entries.text:
鼻子最亮的驯鹿，
也有最温暖的心。

entries.source: Return to title? Continue resumes from the start of this night.
entries.text: 返回标题？继续冒险时将从本晚开始处恢复。

entries.source: A lovely gift lit up the night.
entries.text: 温暖的礼物点亮了夜晚。

entries.source: A child is waiting for Christmas.
entries.text: 有个孩子正在等待圣诞节。

entries.source: A powerful foe guards a relic.
entries.text: 强大的敌人守护着遗物。

entries.source: Rest, rewrap a gift or write to Santa.
entries.text: 休息、升级礼物，或给圣诞老人写信。

entries.source: Spend Cookies on gifts, relics and potions.
entries.text: 用饼干购买礼物、遗物和药水。

entries.source: A stocking stuffed with a relic.

entries.text: 奇妙的际遇正等待着你。
今晚只能选择一个地点。

entries.source: Drag, scroll or use arrow keys
entries.text: 拖动、滚轮或方向键移动地图

entries.source: Hover or tap a gift to inspect it.
entries.text: 悬停或轻触礼物，查看详细效果。

entries.source: Choose one gift. Hover to read its effect.
entries.text: 选择一张礼物，悬停可查看效果。

entries.source: Then choose a gift to fit it on.
entries.text: 随后选择一张礼物进行安装。

entries.source: is asleep. Leave a gift under the tree.
entries.text: 已经熟睡。请在树下留下一份礼物。

entries.source: LEAVE A GIFT UNDER THE TREE
Your sack is too light to spare a gift.
entries.text: 礼袋里的礼物太少，无法再送出了。

entries.source: You doze by the crackling fire. The aches fade away.
entries.text: 你在噼啪作响的壁炉旁打起了盹，疲惫渐渐消散。

entries.source: Ribbons tied, bows fluffed. Good as new.
entries.text: 系好缎带，整理蝴蝶结。礼物焕然一新。

entries.source:
Dear Nick, remember the boy who carved toys for everyone?
+8 Spirit
entries.text:
亲爱的尼克，还记得那个给大家雕刻玩具的男孩吗？
圣诞精神+8
这只圣诞袜里好像装着什么……

entries.source:
Welcome to the
Elf Shop!

Everything here
is hand-made.
entries.text:
欢迎光临
精灵商店！

这里的东西
都是手工制作。

entries.source: None of your gifts has room for it!
entries.text: 没有能安装此配件的礼物！

entries.source: You haven't met this monster yet.
entries.text: 你还没有遇到过这只怪物。
这才是真正美好的圣诞节！

entries.source:
The list is torn. Every friend you were kind to
came to help. Santa remembers who he is.
entries.text:
名单被撕碎。你曾善待的伙伴们前来相助，
圣诞老人终于找回了自己。

entries.source:
The coal falls away. Santa is himself again.
Christmas Day is safe.
entries.text:
煤灰散去，圣诞老人恢复了原样。
圣诞节得救了。

entries.source: Spent to give gifts. Refills every turn.
entries.text: 赠送礼物需要消耗欢呼，每回合补满。
礼袋中的礼物（顺序隐藏）

entries.source: Click to view. Order is hidden.
entries.text: 点击查看，抽牌顺序不会显示。

entries.source: Refills the Sack when it runs out.
entries.text: 抽牌堆耗尽后重新洗入礼袋。

entries.source: CHOOSE A MONSTER / RIGHT CLICK TO CANCEL
entries.text: 选择一只怪物，右键取消

entries.source: Leave it unharmed to win it over.
entries.text: 不要伤害它，它就会成为伙伴。
已软化，未受伤便会加入

entries.source: Not enough Cheer, or this gift is ungiftable.
entries.text: 欢呼不足，或这张礼物无法赠送。

entries.source: Give it gifts it loves. Leave it unharmed once Softened.
entries.text: 赠送它喜爱的礼物。软化后不要再伤害它。

entries.source: This enemy cannot be won over.
Replaces any part already on the gift. Permanent for gifts in your sack.
entries.text: 替换该礼物已有的配件。礼袋中的礼物会永久保留改装。

entries.source: You still have Cheer and gifts you can give. End your turn anyway?
entries.text: 还有欢呼和可赠送的礼物。仍要结束回合吗？

entries.source: A little Christmas magic lights up the night.
entries.text: 一点圣诞魔法，点亮了这个夜晚。

entries.source: The house stays quiet in the snow.
entries.text: 房屋在雪中依然静悄悄。

entries.source: Choose a toy part to add to a gift in your hand. Fills as you play gifts.
entries.text: 选择配件，安装到手牌中的礼物。赠送礼物和触发配件时充能。

entries.source: The next reindeer of Santa's team gallops in to help. Fills when you take damage.
entries.text: 召唤队列中的下一头驯鹿前来援助。受到伤害或格挡时充能。

entries.source: Pick a monster: pop 1 Grumpy pip, learn what it loves and apply a random debuff. Fills from Skills and Grumpy pips.
entries.text: 选择怪物：降低1格暴躁值，揭示喜好并施加随机减益。使用技能或降低暴躁值时充能。

entries.source: Apply 2 Soggy and 2 Brittle to a random enemy.
entries.text: 对随机敌人施加2层湿透和2层易碎。

entries.source: Deal 20 damage to a random enemy.
entries.text: 对随机敌人造成20点伤害。

entries.source: Pop 2 Grumpy pips on a random monster.
entries.text: 降低随机怪物的2格暴躁值。
对所有敌人造成8点伤害。

entries.source: Deal 4 damage 5 times to random enemies.
entries.text: 对随机敌人造成4点伤害，重复5次。

entries.source: Start with a Lump of Coal.
entries.text: 初始牌组加入一张煤块。
休息时恢复的生命减少。
怪物额外拥有1格暴躁值。
圣诞老人和坎卜斯变得更强。
我想要会吱吱叫的礼物！

entries.source: I want something that plays music!

entries.text: 我想要叮当作响的礼物！

entries.source: I want a present with a big bow!
entries.text: 我想要有大蝴蝶结的礼物！
我想要闪闪发亮的礼物！

entries.source: I want something warm and cosy!
entries.text: 我想要温暖舒服的礼物！

entries.source: I want something I can throw!
entries.text: 我想要能扔出去的礼物！

entries.source: I want something rare and shiny!
entries.text: 我想要稀有又漂亮的礼物！
每层使攻击伤害增加1点。
每层使礼物提供的护甲增加1点。

entries.source: Attack damage -25%. Drops by 1 each turn.
entries.text: 攻击伤害降低25%，每回合减少1层。

entries.source: Attack damage taken +50%. Drops by 1 each turn.
entries.text: 受到的攻击伤害增加50%，每回合减少1层。

entries.source: Wrap gained -25%. Drops by 1 each turn.
entries.text: 获得的护甲减少25%，每回合减少1层。

entries.source: Lose this much HP at turn start; then drops by 1.
entries.text: 回合开始时失去等同层数的生命，随后减少1层。

entries.source: Attackers take this much damage back.
entries.text: 攻击者受到等同层数的反伤。

entries.source: Gain this much Might at end of turn.
entries.text: 回合结束时获得等同层数的力量。

entries.source: Heal this much at turn start.
entries.text: 回合开始时恢复等同层数的生命。

entries.source: Negates the next debuff per stack.
Gain this much Wrap at end of turn.
entries.text: 回合结束时获得等同层数的护甲。

entries.source: Deal this much damage to ALL enemies at turn end.
entries.text: 回合结束时对所有敌人造成等同层数的伤害。

entries.source: Apply this much Frostbite to ALL at turn start.
entries.text: 回合开始时对所有敌人施加等同层数的冻伤。

entries.source: Draw this many extra gifts every turn.
entries.text: 每回合额外抽取等同层数的礼物。

entries.source: Gain this much Cheer every turn.
entries.text: 每回合获得等同层数的欢呼。

entries.source: Gain this much Might every turn.
entries.text: 每回合获得等同层数的力量。

entries.source: SOFTENED! Leave it be to win it over.
entries.text: 已软化！不再伤害它，就能收服。

entries.source: The LIST... it was the list all along!
entries.text: 那份名单……原来一切都是名单的错！

entries.source:
Fades by 1 each night.
0-24: draw 1 fewer.
25-49: Krampus grows stronger.
50-69: Merry.
70-89: +1 Cheer on turn 1.
90-100: +1 Cheer each turn.
Leave gifts and fulfill wishes to raise it.
entries.text:
每晚降低1点。
0—24：少抽1张礼物。
25—49：坎卜斯更强。
50—69：愉快。
70—89：首回合欢呼+1。
90—100：每回合欢呼+1。
留下礼物、实现愿望可提升精神。

entries.source:
.

Spirit fades every night. Leave gifts to keep Christmas alive.

Grim: draw 1 fewer. Fading: Krampus grows stronger. Merry: kids still believe. Festive: +1 Cheer on the first turn. Jolly: +1 Cheer every turn.
entries.text:
。

圣诞精神每晚都会流失。留下礼物，让圣诞的希望延续。

黯淡：少抽1张。衰落：坎卜斯更强。愉快：孩子们仍相信圣诞。喜庆：首回合欢呼+1。欢欣：每回合欢呼+1。

entries.source:
Give Gifts using Cheer. Choose a gift, then a monster; drag-and-drop also works. Cheer refills each turn. Wrap absorbs damage until your next turn. E ends the turn. P uses your charged power.

Fit toy parts to gifts. Give monsters things they love to pop Grumpy pips. A Softened monster skips its turn and joins you if you leave it unharmed. Hitting it breaks its trust.

Take rewards, then leave a gift for a child. Fulfill their wish for +4 Spirit. Your sack needs at least 5 gifts. Spirit fades nightly and changes Krampus's strength.

Beat all 24 nights. Can you bring Santa home without hurting him?
entries.text:
消耗欢呼来赠送礼物。先选礼物，再选怪物，也可以拖拽赠送。欢呼每回合补满，护甲可抵挡伤害，持续至下回合。E键结束回合，Q键或P键使用充能能力。

给礼物安装配件。赠送怪物喜爱的礼物可降低暴躁值。软化的怪物会跳过行动；不再伤害它，它就会成为伙伴。攻击它则会破坏信任。

领取奖励后，给孩子留下一份礼物。实现愿望额外获得4点精神。礼袋至少保留5张礼物。精神每晚流失，并影响坎卜斯的实力。

度过全部24晚。你能在不伤害圣诞老人的情况下带他回家吗？

entries.source: 'Twas the night before Christmas, and all through the land,
entries.text: 圣诞前夜，白雪覆盖大地，

entries.source: Not a sleigh bell was jingling, not a reindeer at hand.
entries.text: 不闻雪橇铃声，不见驯鹿踪迹。

entries.source: For Santa had read the long Naughty List through,
entries.text: 圣诞老人读完了漫长的顽皮名单，

entries.source: And each name that he read made his heart darker, too.
entries.text: 每念一个名字，心头便多一分黑暗。

entries.source: Till one frosty midnight, he grabbed his big sack
entries.text: 直到一个霜冷的午夜，他抓起礼袋，

entries.source: And ran off the North Pole with the coal on his back.
entries.text: 背着煤炭，独自离开北极。

entries.source: But up at his home, by the fire's warm glow,
entries.text: 而家中，炉火仍映着温暖的光，

entries.source: But down in the workshop, by lantern-light's glow,
entries.text: 而工坊里，灯笼仍映着温暖的光，

entries.source: But out in the stable, his nose all aglow,
entries.text: 而鹿舍中，一只红鼻子闪着光，

entries.source: Sat wise Mrs. Claus. She won't let it go!
entries.text: 克劳斯夫人决心不再坐视不管！

entries.source: Worked Tinsel the elf, who would not let it go!
entries.text: 精灵廷瑟决心不再坐视不管！

entries.source: Stood Rudolph the reindeer, who would not let go!
entries.text: 驯鹿鲁道夫决心不再坐视不管！
“距离圣诞清晨还有二十五晚，

entries.source: I'll keep Christmas living, whatever it takes!
entries.text: 无论付出什么，也要让圣诞延续！

entries.source: I'll fight every monster from here to the Pole
entries.text: 我要打败沿途怪物，直抵北极，

entries.source: And bring my dear husband back, body and soul!"
entries.text: 把我亲爱的丈夫完整地带回家！”

entries.source: "Twenty-five nights till the Christmas bells chime.
entries.text: “距离圣诞钟响还有二十五晚，

entries.source: I'll mend every toy and I'll do it in time!
entries.text: 我要修好所有玩具，赶在期限之前！

entries.source: I'll hammer and tinker my way to the Pole
entries.text: 我要一路敲敲打打，直抵北极，

entries.source: And bring the boss back, body and soul!"
entries.text: 把我们的老板完整地带回家！”

entries.source: "Twenty-five nights till the sleigh bells will chime.
entries.text: “距离雪橇铃响还有二十五晚，

entries.source: I'll light up the dark and the cold, all in time!
entries.text: 我要及时照亮黑暗，驱散严寒！

entries.source: I'll gallop through blizzards from here to the Pole
entries.text: 我要穿越沿途暴雪，直抵北极，

entries.source: And bring Santa back, body and soul!"
entries.text: 把圣诞老人完整地带回家！”

entries.source: The Naughty List shredded, its dark magic fled,
entries.text: 顽皮名单化为碎片，黑暗魔法消散，

entries.source: The Krampus fell silent, the dark shadow fled
entries.text: 坎卜斯归于沉寂，黑暗阴影消散，

entries.source: And Santa stood laughing, his cheeks rosy red.
entries.text: 圣诞老人放声大笑，双颊又红润起来。

entries.source: And Santa stood blinking, his cheeks rosy red.
entries.text: 圣诞老人眨眨眼，双颊又红润起来。
“玛莎，”他轻声说，“是你救了圣诞节！”
“廷瑟，”他轻声说，“是你救了圣诞节！”
“小鲁迪，”他轻声说，“是你救了圣诞节！”

entries.source: "I know, dear," she said. "Now get on that sleigh!"
entries.text: “我知道，亲爱的。快坐上雪橇吧！”

entries.source: "I know, boss," she grinned. "Now get on that sleigh!"
So Rudolph just snorted and lit up the way.
entries.text: 鲁道夫喷了个响鼻，再次照亮前方。

entries.source: And all of the friends that were won on the way
entries.text: 旅途中结识的所有伙伴，

entries.source: Climbed into the sleigh for the ride Christmas Day.
entries.text: 都登上雪橇，一起迎接圣诞清晨。

entries.source: And kids heard them say as they flew out of sight:
entries.text: 雪橇渐渐远去，孩子们听见祝愿：

entries.source: "Merry Christmas to all! Have a jolly good night!"
entries.text: “祝大家圣诞快乐，度过美好的夜晚！”

entries.source: The elf's family gives you their heirloom:
entries.text: 精灵一家送给你传家宝：

entries.source: He waves goodbye and skips off whistling a carol.
entries.text: 他挥手道别，哼着颂歌蹦蹦跳跳地走了。

entries.source: His little sobs follow you into the night.
entries.text: 细小的抽泣声追着你的背影，融进夜色。

entries.source: You work late into the night.
Some places are best left alone.
entries.text: 有些地方还是别打扰为好。

entries.source: For one verse, the whole street glows warmer.
entries.text: 一曲唱罢，整条街似乎都暖了起来。

entries.source: They hand you a steaming flask:
entries.text: 他们递给你一瓶热气腾腾的药水：

entries.source: Terribly out of tune, just how you like it.
entries.text: 跑调得厉害，却正合你的心意。

entries.source: You glide across and chip out a fistful of coins!
entries.text: 你滑过冰面，凿出一把闪亮的硬币！
咔嚓！冰破了。冷得直打哆嗦。

entries.source: The long way. A whole hour lost.
entries.text: 你绕了远路，白白耽搁了一小时。

entries.source: Your hand closes on cookies... and something sooty.
entries.text: 你抓到了饼干……还有一块黑乎乎的东西。
圣诞老人一定也希望你这样做。

entries.source: The flakes swirl... and something changes.
entries.text: 雪花旋转……有什么悄然改变了。

entries.source: Her eyes follow you down the street.
entries.text: 她的目光追着你，直到街道尽头。

entries.source: They nuzzle you gratefully. You feel sturdier.
entries.text: 它们感激地蹭着你，你也感觉更有精神了。
真是疯狂的一程！你找到了
它们不耐烦地跺着蹄子。

entries.source: Somewhere, a child's wish comes true.
entries.text: 不知何处，一个孩子的心愿实现了。

entries.source: The game is called TAG. You're IT!
entries.text: 游戏叫捉人，现在轮到你来追了！

entries.source: They kick your shins before running away.
entries.text: 它们临走前还踢了你的小腿一脚。

entries.source: Three fine toys roll off the line.
entries.text: 三件精致的玩具滑下了生产线。

entries.source: The hum of machines lulls you to sleep.
entries.text: 机器的嗡鸣声让你渐渐睡着。

entries.source: Delicious! ...Wait, why is the gutter made of coal?
entries.text: 真好吃！等等，为什么排水槽是煤做的？

entries.source: The door creaks open. Come in, dearie!
entries.text: 门吱呀一声打开。“进来吧，亲爱的！”

entries.source: The cackling stops. You don't look back.
entries.text: 怪笑声停了。你没有回头。

entries.source: They ring once, clear and bright, across the valley.
entries.text: 铃声清亮，久久回荡在山谷之间。

entries.source: His frown wobbles... and cracks into a grin.
entries.text: 他皱着的眉头渐渐松开，露出了笑容。

entries.source: You lose in a very pathetic fashion.
He drops his pocket money and runs.
entries.text: 他扔下零花钱，转身跑了。

entries.source: A warm feeling spreads through you.
He shows you his finest work.
entries.text: 他拿出了最得意的作品。

entries.source: You emerge frostbitten but on schedule.
entries.text: 你冻得发抖，总算没有耽误行程。
几个小时就这样过去了。

entries.source: Warm and toasty, you march on.
Every letter is a tiny, hopeful heart.
entries.text: 每一封信，都是一颗小小的、充满希望的心。

entries.source: Mailbox after mailbox, the village lights up.
entries.text: 一个又一个信箱被填满，村庄渐渐亮了起来。

entries.source: The fire is warm, but your heart isn't.
entries.text: 火很暖，你的心却没有暖起来。
两瓶药水，瓶塞都仔细塞好了。
反正耐心也没那么重要。

entries.source: A sunken purse full of cookies!
entries.text: 沉底的钱袋里装满了饼干！

entries.source: An angry pike bites your finger.
entries.text: 愤怒的梭鱼咬了你的手指。

entries.source: Your feet ache, but your spirit soars.
entries.text: 双脚酸痛，心情却无比轻快。
音乐声渐渐消失在身后。
有人会收到一份大惊喜。

entries.source: You laugh like a child. When did you last do that?
entries.text: 你笑得像个孩子。上一次这样开心是什么时候？

entries.source: It settles warmly in your sack.
entries.text: 星星温暖地落进你的礼袋。
它化作了一把金灿灿的硬币。

entries.source: It rises back into the sky. The world around you feels brighter.
entries.text: 它重回夜空，周围的世界似乎更亮了。

entries.source: The stranger vanishes in a puff of smoke.
entries.text: 陌生人消失在一团烟雾中。

entries.source: Two snowmen, side by side. What a jolly sight!
entries.text: 两个雪人并肩站着，多么快乐的景象！

entries.source: He watches you go with coal-black eyes.
entries.text: 它用煤黑的眼睛目送你远去。
你从回忆里带回了什么。

entries.source: That's the man you're fighting for.
entries.text: 这就是你拼尽全力也要拯救的人。

entries.source: So many coins, so many shattered memories.
entries.text: 满地硬币，也满地破碎的回忆。

entries.source: Sugar Rush! Gain {b} Wrap. Gain {k1} Might. Consume.
entries.text: 糖分冲刺！获得{b}点护甲。获得{k1}层力量。消耗。

entries.source: Frost Glare! Apply {k0} Chilled. Gain {b} Wrap. Consume.
entries.text: 寒霜凝视！施加{k0}层寒冷。获得{b}点护甲。消耗。
碎片迸射！造成{d}点伤害，重复2次。消耗。
吱吱叫！获得{k0}层力量。消耗。
上发条！获得{k0}层力量。消耗。

entries.source: Stand Guard! Gain {b} Wrap. Deal {d} damage. Consume.
entries.text: 站岗守卫！获得{b}点护甲。造成{d}点伤害。消耗。
齐射！造成{d}点伤害，重复3次。消耗。

entries.source: Wing Gust! Deal {d} damage x2. Consume.
entries.text: 振翅狂风！造成{d}点伤害，重复2次。消耗。

entries.source: Splash! Deal {d} damage. Apply {k1} Soggy. Consume.
entries.text: 泼洒！造成{d}点伤害。施加{k1}层湿透。消耗。

entries.source: Swipe! Deal {d} damage. Gain {k1} Cookies. Consume.
entries.text: 横抓！造成{d}点伤害。获得{k1}块饼干。消耗。

entries.source: Pickpocket! Deal {d} damage. Gain {k1} Cookies. Consume.
entries.text: 偷窃！造成{d}点伤害。获得{k1}块饼干。消耗。
煤炭重拳！造成{d}点伤害。消耗。

entries.source: Fangs! Deal {d} damage. Apply {k1} Frostbite. Consume.
entries.text: 毒牙！造成{d}点伤害。施加{k1}层冻伤。消耗。

entries.source: Grow! Gain {k0} Holly. Gain {b} Wrap. Consume.
entries.text: 生长！获得{k0}层冬青。获得{b}点护甲。消耗。

entries.source: Iron Jaw! Deal {d} damage x2. Apply {k1} Brittle. Consume.
entries.text: 铁颚！造成{d}点伤害，重复2次。施加{k1}层易碎。消耗。

entries.source: Stockpile! Gain {b} Wrap. Gain {k1} Tinsel. Consume.
entries.text: 囤积！获得{b}点护甲。获得{k1}层彩带。消耗。
鹿角突刺！造成{d}点伤害。消耗。

entries.source: Hex! Deal {d} damage. Apply {k1} Chilled. Consume.
entries.text: 诅咒术！造成{d}点伤害。施加{k1}层寒冷。消耗。

entries.source: Freeze Over! Apply {k0} Frostbite. Apply {k1} Chilled. Consume.
entries.text: 冰封！施加{k0}层冻伤。施加{k1}层寒冷。消耗。
对所有敌人施加1层易碎。
